description: Thermal, oil, and dynamics calibration parameters (Phase B) - fitted against [FIT] flight data

provenance.procedure: Phase B: prediction-error least-squares (scipy trf) against REAL Rotax 915 iS Dynon CAN-bus data
provenance.fit_source: NTSB docket WPR22LA211 (RANS S21, N46JH, SN13785), DYNON FLIGHT DATA-USER LOG DATA-RAW CSV
provenance.caveat: Single accident flight; not a healthy-segment-selected calibration set per spec Sec 3.1. This IS the correct engine type (915 iS), unlike the earlier NGAFID-derived fit.

thermal_capacitances.description: Thermal capacitances for head, oil, and cylinder nodes

cooling_conductances.description: Cooling-airflow conductances with V_TAS^0.8 * rho^0.8 form

asymmetry_factors.description: Fixed per-cylinder asymmetry factors a_i [FIT] - rear cylinders run hotter
asymmetry_factors.description_note: Values represent relative cooling efficiency differences

heat_transfer_to_head.description: Fraction of heat going to head vs exhaust

friction_heat.description: Fraction of friction heat going to oil

oil_viscosity.description: Oil viscosity model mu(T_oil) - Vogel/Walther fit

provenance.procedure: least-squares fit against real Rotax 915iS OIL PRES (CAN) vs RPM/T_oil data
provenance.caveat: Previously hardcoded literals (3000, 500, 100) produced ~1-2 Pa predicted oil pressure vs real ~300-450 kPa -- off by 5 orders of magnitude. This is a real fit, not a placeholder.
